userSnippets.name: Pac-Man Tile Collection
userSnippets.code:
; Pac-Man Style Tile Collection System for MSX
; Optimized for MSX hardware limitations
; Uses: DE = Player position, HL = Screen map address

COLLECT_TILES:
    ; Input: DE = Player X,Y position (D=X, E=Y)
    ; Input: HL = Screen map base address
    ; Output: A = Number of items collected
    ; Destroys: BC, DE, HL
    
    push bc
    push de
    push hl
    
    ld a, 0                    ; Initialize collection counter
    ld (COLLECTION_COUNT), a
    
    ; Convert pixel position to tile coordinates
    ld a, d                    ; Player X
    srl a                      ; Divide by 2
    srl a                      ; Divide by 4
    srl a                      ; Divide by 8 (assuming 8x8 tiles)
    ld d, a                    ; D = Tile X
    
    ld a, e                    ; Player Y  
    srl a                      ; Divide by 2
    srl a                      ; Divide by 4
    srl a                      ; Divide by 8
    ld e, a                    ; E = Tile Y
    
    ; Calculate tile address: HL + (Y * MAP_WIDTH) + X
    ld a, e                    ; Y coordinate
    ld b, 0
    ld c, 32                   ; MAP_WIDTH (assuming 32 tiles wide)
    call MULTIPLY_AC           ; A = Y * MAP_WIDTH
    
    add a, d                   ; A = (Y * MAP_WIDTH) + X
    ld c, a
    ld b, 0
    add hl, bc                 ; HL points to tile at player position
    
    ; Check if current tile is collectible
    ld a, (hl)                 ; Load tile ID
    cp DOT_TILE_ID             ; Compare with dot tile
    jr z, COLLECT_DOT
    cp POWERUP_TILE_ID         ; Compare with power-up tile
    jr z, COLLECT_POWERUP
    cp FRUIT_TILE_ID           ; Compare with fruit tile
    jr z, COLLECT_FRUIT
    jr END_COLLECTION          ; Nothing to collect
    
COLLECT_DOT:
    ld a, EMPTY_TILE_ID        ; Replace with empty tile
    ld (hl), a
    ld a, (SCORE)              ; Load current score
    add a, 10                  ; Add 10 points for dot
    ld (SCORE), a
    ld a, (DOT_COUNT)          ; Increment dot counter
    inc a
    ld (DOT_COUNT), a
    call PLAY_DOT_SOUND        ; Play collection sound
    jr INCREMENT_COLLECTION

COLLECT_POWERUP:
    ld a, EMPTY_TILE_ID
    ld (hl), a
    ld a, (SCORE)
    add a, 50                  ; Add 50 points for power-up
    ld (SCORE), a
    ld a, 1
    ld (POWER_MODE), a         ; Activate power mode
    call PLAY_POWERUP_SOUND
    jr INCREMENT_COLLECTION

COLLECT_FRUIT:
    ld a, EMPTY_TILE_ID
    ld (hl), a
    ld a, (SCORE)
    add a, 100                 ; Add 100 points for fruit
    ld (SCORE), a
    ld a, (FRUIT_COUNT)
    inc a
    ld (FRUIT_COUNT), a
    call PLAY_FRUIT_SOUND
    jr INCREMENT_COLLECTION

INCREMENT_COLLECTION:
    ld a, (COLLECTION_COUNT)
    inc a
    ld (COLLECTION_COUNT), a

END_COLLECTION:
    ld a, (COLLECTION_COUNT)   ; Return collection count in A
    
    pop hl
    pop de
    pop bc
    ret

; Helper routine: Multiply A * C, result in A
MULTIPLY_AC:
    ld b, 0
    ld h, b
    ld l, a
    ld d, h
    ld e, l
    add hl, hl                 ; HL = A * 2
    jr nc, MUL_NO_CARRY1
    inc de
MUL_NO_CARRY1:
    add hl, hl                 ; HL = A * 4
    jr nc, MUL_NO_CARRY2
    inc de
MUL_NO_CARRY2:
    add hl, hl                 ; HL = A * 8
    jr nc, MUL_NO_CARRY3
    inc de
MUL_NO_CARRY3:
    add hl, hl                 ; HL = A * 16
    jr nc, MUL_NO_CARRY4
    inc de
MUL_NO_CARRY4:
    add hl, hl                 ; HL = A * 32
    ld a, l
    ret

; Sound effect stubs (implement based on your sound system)
PLAY_DOT_SOUND:
    ; Play dot collection sound
    ret
    
PLAY_POWERUP_SOUND:
    ; Play power-up sound
    ret
    
PLAY_FRUIT_SOUND:
    ; Play fruit collection sound
    ret

; Data section
DOT_TILE_ID:        EQU 1      ; Tile ID for collectible dots
POWERUP_TILE_ID:    EQU 2      ; Tile ID for power-ups
FRUIT_TILE_ID:      EQU 3      ; Tile ID for bonus fruits
EMPTY_TILE_ID:      EQU 0      ; Tile ID for empty space

; Memory variables
COLLECTION_COUNT:   DB 0       ; Items collected this frame
SCORE:              DW 0       ; Player score
DOT_COUNT:          DB 0       ; Total dots collected
FRUIT_COUNT:        DB 0       ; Total fruits collected
POWER_MODE:         DB 0       ; Power-up mode active flag

componentDefinitions.name: Position

properties.name: x
properties.description: Horizontal position (pixel units or grid units depending on context)

properties.name: y

componentDefinitions.description: Defines an entity's 2D coordinates.

componentDefinitions.name: Carry
componentDefinitions.description: Configures how the entity carries objects (e.g., vertical offset above head).

properties.name: offset
properties.description: Vertical pixels between hero head and carried object (0 = pegado).

properties.name: carrySpriteAssetId
properties.description: Optional sprite to display while the entity is carrying another object.

componentDefinitions.name: Box
componentDefinitions.description: Marks this entity as a carriable box that can be picked up and moved.

properties.name: isCarriable
properties.description: Whether this box can be picked up by entities with comp_carry.

componentDefinitions.name: Renderable

properties.name: spriteAssetId
properties.description: ID of the sprite asset to render

properties.name: isVisible
properties.description: Whether the entity is currently visible

properties.name: layer
properties.description: Render layer (0=bg, 1=main, 2=fg)

componentDefinitions.description: Allows an entity to be drawn on screen using a sprite.

componentDefinitions.name: Behavior

properties.name: scriptAssetId
properties.description: ID of the behavior script to run

componentDefinitions.description: Attaches a behavior script to an entity.

componentDefinitions.name: Health

componentDefinitions.name: Jump
componentDefinitions.description: Manages jumping behavior for an entity.

properties.name: jumpPower
properties.description: Initial upward velocity or force.

properties.name: jumpSprite
properties.description: Sprite to use while jumping.

properties.name: maxJumps
properties.description: Number of jumps allowed before landing.

properties.name: currentJumpCount
properties.description: Current jump count.

properties.name: isJumping
properties.description: Is the entity currently jumping?

properties.name: requireKeyRelease
properties.description: If true, jump key must be released before jumping again.

componentDefinitions.name: Gravity
componentDefinitions.description: Applies gravitational force to an entity.

properties.name: strength
properties.description: Acceleration due to gravity.

properties.name: terminalVelocity
properties.description: Maximum falling speed.

componentDefinitions.name: Animation
componentDefinitions.description: Manages sprite animation sequences for an entity.

properties.name: currentAnimationName
properties.description: Name of the current animation (e.g., 'idle', 'walk').

properties.name: currentFrameIndex
properties.description: Current frame in the animation.

properties.name: animationSpeed
properties.description: Ticks/frames per animation update.

properties.name: loops
properties.description: Does the animation loop?

properties.name: isPlaying
properties.description: Is the animation currently playing?

properties.name: animateOnlyWhenMoving
properties.description: Only animate when entity has non-zero velocity (vx or vy).

componentDefinitions.name: Collision

properties.name: hitboxWidth
properties.description: Width of the collision bounding box.

properties.name: hitboxHeight
properties.description: Height of the collision bounding box.

properties.name: offsetX
properties.description: Horizontal offset of the hitbox from the entity's origin.

properties.name: offsetY
properties.description: Vertical offset of the hitbox from the entity's origin.

properties.name: collisionLayer
properties.description: Bitmask defining the entity's collision group (e.g., 1=player, 2=enemy).

properties.name: collidesWith
properties.description: Bitmask defining which layers this entity can collide with.

properties.name: isStatic
properties.description: If true, this entity is immovable and won't be pushed by collisions. Other entities will be pushed away when colliding with static entities.

properties.name: isTrigger
properties.description: If true, collision is detected for events but entities pass through each other (no physical pushback). Use for collectibles, checkpoints, damage zones. If false, entities push/separate on collision (solid collision).

componentDefinitions.description: Defines the physical shape and interaction rules for entity-to-entity collisions. Supports both solid (pushback) and trigger (overlap-only) collision modes.

componentDefinitions.name: Wall Collision

properties.name: hitboxWidth
properties.description: Width of the collision bounding box for wall detection.

properties.name: hitboxHeight
properties.description: Height of the collision bounding box for wall detection.

properties.name: offsetX
properties.description: Horizontal offset of the hitbox from the entity's origin.

properties.name: offsetY
properties.description: Vertical offset of the hitbox from the entity's origin.

properties.name: tileSize
properties.description: Size of tiles in the collision layer (usually 8x8 for MSX).

properties.name: stopOnCollision
properties.description: Whether to stop entity movement when hitting a wall.

componentDefinitions.description: Defines collision detection with solid tiles in the collision layer (walls, obstacles).

componentDefinitions.name: Physics

properties.name: velocityX
properties.description: Horizontal speed (fixed-point 8.8 or integer).

properties.name: velocityY
properties.description: Vertical speed (fixed-point 8.8 or integer).

properties.name: friction
properties.description: Damping factor for velocity (0-255, where 255 is no friction).

properties.name: mass
properties.description: Mass of the entity, affecting knockback etc.

componentDefinitions.description: Governs basic physical properties like velocity. Works with Gravity and Jump.

componentDefinitions.description: Marks an entity as an item that can be picked up.

properties.name: targetEntityTemplateId
properties.description: The type of entity to aim at.

properties.name: aimingRange
properties.description: Maximum distance to acquire a target.

properties.name: rotationSpeed
properties.description: How fast the entity rotates to face the target (0 for instant).

properties.name: fieldOfView

properties.name: predictsTargetMovement

properties.name: predictionFactor
